question: What makes the goddess the object of worship as the source of all auspiciousness?
premises: All auspiciousness has arisen in her.
Her auspiciousness is united with Śiva.
inference: The goddess is worshipped because she embodies complete auspiciousness in union with Śiva.
uncertainties: Compound segmentation of aṅga+lagna+śiva+sarva+maṅgalām follows traditional reading but internal relations are compact.
plain_english: One worships her, in whom all auspiciousness has arisen, who is all-auspicious through union with Śiva.
